新收的契约兽，先带她钻小树林（新收的契约兽，先带她钻小树林（第22页）“师尊宽心。”
“弟子敬您为师，绝无半点加害利用之念。”
“若师尊仍有疑虑，弟子大可敞开神识灵台，任凭师尊探查神魂。”
墨羽轻笑，翻手取出一枚丹药递了过去。
“这次太过仓促，手头没带什么好东西，正式的拜师礼，等以后再给你补上。”
这丹药是他拿那俩老头的仙丹回炉重炼的，炼成了两百枚药性温和的仙丹，对人仙而言刚刚好。
没有丝毫扭捏与防备，素手轻探，指尖似不经意间触碰到墨羽的手心，将那枚丹药捻起，檀口轻启，便径直吞入腹中。
后方，顾清歌看着这一幕，美眸微眯成了一条细缝。
两人碰到了……墨羽绝对是除她父亲外，首个与她有肌肤之亲的男子。
不仅接触了，甚至还毫不犹豫地吃下了经他手的丹药……这女人行事反常，其中定有不为人知的猫腻。
那枚丹药虽看似温和，隐隐透出的浩瀚法则之力，比他这辈子见过的任何顶级仙丹都要恐怖不知多少倍。
这师弟……出手未免也太过阔绰、手段太过通天了吧！
玉倾心感受到体内骤然化开的磅礴药力，周身仙光微漾。
“师尊，我需闭关炼化这枚丹药，劳烦师尊为我护法。”
这倒是个独处的好机会，可以私下查查她是怎么回事。
直接带着她往下方群山中的一处偏僻密林落去。
随着手腕一翻，一座机关庭院拔地而起，落于林间。

墨羽径直推门走入，玉倾心紧随其后。
天玄子过了好久才渐渐从震撼中缓过神来，转头看向身旁的叶汐湄。
“老师……您不回天玄仙宗住上几日？”
天玄子犹豫了一下，小心翼翼地问。
“老师，小师弟他如此妖孽，您如今的修为……”
他隐隐能感觉到，老师的气息仿佛与整个天地融为一体，浩瀚无垠，远远超出了他的认知极限。
叶汐湄唇角微扬，云淡风轻地吐出几个字。
“也就比圣源界最强的那位准帝……稍微强了亿点点吧。”
天玄子双目猛地瞪大，眼白差点翻过去。
那个字卡在喉咙里，怎么也说不出来。
天玄子只觉脑海中有万道天雷同时炸响，惊得神魂巨震。
下一秒，他感觉周遭的时间陷入了某种诡异的停滞之中。
仿佛经历了亿万年的沧海桑田、即将寿终正寝。
可转瞬之间，又好似回溯了时光，重归牙牙学语时的懵懂幼年。
当他满头大汗地从那可怕的岁月长河幻象中猛然惊醒时。
冷汗已浸透衣衫，而眼前，叶汐湄早已消失无踪。
只余下一道飘渺威仪的嗓音，在识海中悠悠回荡。
天玄子双膝一软，重重跪在虚空之中，恭敬叩首。

For the newly acquired contracted beast, take her into the grove first (for the newly acquired contracted beast, take her into the grove first (page 22) "Master, please be at ease."
"My disciples respect you as their teacher and have absolutely no intention of harming or exploiting you."
"If the master still has doubts, the disciple can open the spiritual consciousness platform and let the master explore the soul."
Mo Yu chuckled, turned over his hand and took out a pill and handed it over.
"This time it was too hasty and I didn't bring anything good with me. I will make up for the formal apprenticeship ceremony for you later."
He took the elixirs of the two old men and refined them into two hundred elixirs with mild properties, which were just right for human immortals.
Without any hesitation or precaution, he lightly explored with his bare hand, and his fingertips seemed to touch Mo Yu's palm accidentally. He twisted up the elixir, opened his mouth lightly, and swallowed it straight into his belly.
Behind, Lu Qingge watched this scene, his beautiful eyes narrowed into a thin slit.
The two of them met... Mo Yu was definitely the first man besides her father to have physical contact with her.
Not only did she come into contact with her, but she even took the elixir that passed through his hands without hesitation... This woman acted abnormally, and there must be something fishy about it that no one knew about.
Although the elixir seemed gentle, the power of the vast law that was faintly revealed was countless times more terrifying than any top elixir he had ever seen in his life.
This junior brother... his actions are too generous and his methods are too extraordinary!
Yu Qingxin felt the majestic power of the medicine that suddenly dissolved in her body, and her whole body was filled with fairy light.
"Master, I need to retreat to refine this elixir. Please ask Master to protect me."
This would be a good opportunity to be alone and find out what was going on with her in private.
He took her directly to a remote dense forest in the mountains below.
With a flick of his wrist, a mechanism courtyard rose from the ground and landed in the forest.
Mo Yu pushed open the door and walked in, followed closely by Yu Qingxin.
It took a long time for Tian Xuanzi to gradually recover from the shock, and turned to look at Ye Ximei beside him.
"Teacher...how many days will you stay at Tianxuan Immortal Sect?"
Tian Xuanzi hesitated and asked cautiously.
"Teacher, Junior Brother, he is such a monster, your current cultivation level..."
He could vaguely feel that the teacher's aura seemed to be integrated with the entire world, vast and boundless, far beyond the limits of his cognition.
Ye Ximei raised the corners of her lips slightly and uttered a few words softly.
"It's only a little bit stronger than the most powerful quasi-emperor in the Holy Origin Realm..."
Tian Xuanzi's eyes widened suddenly, and the whites of his eyes almost rolled over.
The word was stuck in my throat and I couldn't say it.
Tian Xuanzi felt that thousands of thunders exploded simultaneously in his mind, shocking his soul.
The next second, he felt that time around him had fallen into some strange stasis.
It seems that after hundreds of millions of years of vicissitudes, it is about to die.
But in the blink of an eye, it was like going back in time and returning to the ignorant childhood when I was babbling.
When he suddenly woke up from the terrible illusion of the long river of time, sweating profusely.
Cold sweat had soaked through his clothes, and before his eyes, Ye Ximei had already disappeared without a trace.
Only a vague and majestic voice was left, echoing leisurely in the sea of consciousness.
Tian Xuanzi's knees weakened, and he knelt heavily in the void, kowtowing respectfully.
